title: Dungeon package skeleton + value types (RoomList, EdgeGraph, TileGrid)
description: Create the ixdar.procgen.dungeon package structure and the three port value types consumed by the dungeon node pipeline. Package layout: ixdar.procgen.dungeon.algo (pure-Java algorithms, unit-testable without MeshNode), ixdar.procgen.dungeon.values (port value types), ixdar.procgen.dungeon.nodes (MeshNode wrappers, added in later tickets), ixdar.procgen.dungeon.scene (viewer scene, added in PROCGEN-6). The values package intentionally does NOT live in ixdar.annotations.meshnode — these are dungeon-only types and should not pollute the general mesh schema. RoomListValue: ordered list of AABBs (center + half-extents + integer id). EdgeGraphValue: node array + edges (pair of indices). TileGridValue: 2D array of CellType enum (EMPTY, ROOM, HALLWAY) — STAIR cell types added in 3D extension (PROCGEN-7). Register new PortType enum entries (or equivalent) if the existing PortType doesn't accept new types without registry changes.
definition-of-done: 1. Package ixdar.procgen.dungeon exists with subpackages algo/, values/, nodes/, scene/. 2. RoomListValue.java: record holding List<Room> where Room is (id, centerX, centerY, halfExtentX, halfExtentY). 3. EdgeGraphValue.java: record holding node-count and int[][] edges array (each edge is [fromIdx, toIdx]). 4. TileGridValue.java: record holding width, height, and CellType[] cells (row-major), plus a CellType enum with EMPTY, ROOM, HALLWAY. 5. New PortType enum values registered for ROOM_LIST, EDGE_GRAPH, TILE_GRID (or the equivalent registration mechanism if PortType uses something other than an enum). 6. Package-info.java at ixdar.procgen.dungeon documenting the scoping philosophy.
testing-plan: 1. mvn compile -pl ixdar-app passes. 2. Unit test: construct each value type, verify immutability and defensive copies of arrays. 3. Unit test: PortType new entries are addressable from a MeshNode's InputPort/OutputPort declarations. 4. Manually inspect package layout matches plan.

TileGridValue: immutable record with defensive CellType[] clone, row-major at(x,y) accessor, bounds enforcement
